Change c0542. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): Once my fancy was soothed with dreams of virtue, of fame, and of enjoyment.

1818 text: Once I falsely hoped to meet with beings, who, pardoning my outward form, would love me for the excellent qualities which I was capable of bringing forth.

1831 text: Once I falsely hoped to meet with beings, who, pardoning my outward form, would love me for the excellent qualities which I was capable of unfolding.

Diff: Once I falsely hoped to meet with beings, who, pardoning my outward form, would love me for the excellent qualities which I was capable of [-bringing forth-] {+unfolding+} .

Context after (unchanged): I was nourished with high thoughts of honour and devotion.

result.rationale: Replaces 'bringing forth' with 'unfolding', a shift in verb choice that keeps the same meaning: the creature's qualities are still potential he could realize. Mostly stylistic, though 'unfolding' suggests organic development rather than active production.
